says: In our tooling, the shared Git service's real layer records only the last line of git's output as a GitError's reason, and for git's common fatal errors that line is a usage hint, so the error loses why git refused.
proof: On fabrikalfa/port-0113-s02 at 8b7a8b2, `node .agents/skills/lead/scripts/governance.ts no-such-ref` exits 1 and prints `governance: git diff: exited 128: 'git <command> [<revision>...] -- [<file>...]'`. git's own stderr for that call starts with `fatal: ambiguous argument 'no-such-ref...HEAD': unknown revision or path not in the working tree.`, which the reason drops. GitProcess.ts line 20 builds the reason from `lastLine(ran)` (pr/command.ts line 10, the last non-empty line of stdout and stderr).
cost: Every later port on Git (plan slices S5 and S9 to S14) reports a refused git call with a usage hint in place of the cause, so a person or the lead re-runs git by hand to learn why.
